sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Chain Gang T1. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Melee Charge, 12000 souls (~12.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (vitality): Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Light punches and troopers trigger it too.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Melee Charge, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Have it by about 8 minutes and eat a big camp with it.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-25,600 (levels 15-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bashdown T3, Rising Ram T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Rising Ram, damage) grows from 69.3 to 133. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Melee Charge.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,800 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bashdown (2 to 3).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Bashdown (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you. Takes vitality from 8,800 to 12,000 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 25,600-52,000 (levels 28-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Blasted T3, Chain Gang T3.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it when you chain them in.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 60 to 66 vitality bonus.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Bashdown (channelled) and Rising Ram (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Get it earlier if stuns keep stopping you before you reach them.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Close Quarters.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Close Quarters.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Two or more gun heroes keep hitting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry melts you on the way in.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They kite you and the ram keeps missing.

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..

sections.label: Losing lane (temporary)
sections.legacy_desc: Get Cultist Sacrifice before Extra Health, then carry on.
sections.desc: Get Cultist Sacrifice before Extra Health, then carry on.
